reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes participation in a binary recruitment structure where members must fund a trading account and recruit people into left and right legs to qualify for bonuses. It presents weekly residual income, deeper earning levels tied to larger account amounts, and financial freedom as benefits, then directs viewers to contact a named person to join. The combination of recruitment-dependent compensation, required funding, and passive-income promises makes the central communication an earning solicitation rather than a neutral explanation.

citations.quote: you will also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg
The third person you personally introduce will become spill over for one of the people you introduced before
As your team grows, you can increase your amount in trade so that you can qualify to earn on more levels.

opening.argument: The presentation includes an important limitation that cuts against any reading of guaranteed earnings: bonuses depend on trading performance, and the program expressly says that without trading profits there can be no income or bonuses. It also describes affiliate participation as optional, rather than representing that every viewer must join. The stated bonus caps further frame the material as a defined compensation plan with limits, not an unlimited promise. Those qualifications support viewing this as a conditional referral promotion whose returns depend on an external business result, not deceptive certainty.

citations.quote: if there are no trading profits there can be no income or bonuses.
MTI has an optional affiliate
All referral and binary bonuses cap of $ 15,000 per day and $75,000 per week.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution emphasizes qualification requirements, but requirements are not guarantees. The material expressly conditions income on trading profits, so the cited funding and recruitment terms describe eligibility for a contingent bonus rather than certain returns. Calling the arrangement an earning solicitation also overlooks the stated optional nature of the affiliate program.

citations.quote: if there are no trading profits there can be no income or bonuses.
MTI has an optional affiliate

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A conditional disclaimer does not remove the central inducement. The presentation still advertises "weekly residual income" and describes bonuses based on a weaker leg, while tying eligibility to funded accounts and personally recruited members. Saying profits are required qualifies the promise but does not change the recruitment-dependent structure being promoted.

citations.quote: you will also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg
creating your weekly residual income

opening.argument: The content can reasonably be understood as an explanation of how an affiliate program operates. Its title identifies an Affiliate Program, the description says the affiliate option is optional, and the spoken material walks through referral bonuses, qualification conditions, placement, account tiers, and bonus limits. Explaining how left and right legs, spillover, and levels function is operational instruction about a business model. The material does not document that any participant actually received the described income, so its central activity is describing program mechanics rather than proving or certifying a financial outcome.

citations.quote: Mirror Trading International Affiliate Program
MTI has an optional affiliate
The binary structure works as follows.
All referral and binary bonuses cap of $ 15,000 per day and $75,000 per week.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats every explanation of eligibility as a solicitation, but the supplied speech is structured around explaining the binary system: how members are placed, how levels work, and how bonuses are calculated. Contact information at the end does not establish that the preceding material was a deceptive transaction or that any outcome was guaranteed.

citations.quote: The binary structure works as follows.
with $10,000 and above, you'll receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The format is explanatory, but the explanation itself promotes participation. It calls the payments "residual income," tells viewers to "Join us today," and ends with a contact instruction. The mechanics are not presented as detached analysis; they explain how to qualify, recruit, and earn within the promoted structure.

citations.quote: creating your weekly residual income
Join us today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom.
If you have questions or for more information please contact Clint.

opening.argument: This is most plausibly an ordinary affiliate and business-service promotion, not proof of a scam mechanism. The description characterizes the affiliate option as optional, and the materials identify specific referral and profit-sharing benefits with stated qualification rules and caps. They do not show a completed payment, a victim, a fabricated investment result, or an actual outcome for any participant. Even the claim about financial freedom is framed as a condition involving passive income exceeding expenses and debt, not as evidence that a particular viewer will achieve it. The record therefore supports a promotional business explanation, while leaving the alleged deception unestablished.

citations.quote: MTI has an optional affiliate
10% direct referral bonus
All referral and binary bonuses cap of $ 15,000 per day and $75,000 per week.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Recruitment and account funding can also appear in legitimate affiliate compensation, so their presence alone does not establish fraud. The prosecution identifies no supplied evidence of a fabricated payment, stolen credentials, or a guaranteed return. The materials instead state a conditional profit source and publish limits on the bonuses described.

citations.quote: if there are no trading profits there can be no income or bonuses.
All referral and binary bonuses cap of $ 15,000 per day and $75,000 per week.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The issue is not whether every affiliate program is fraudulent; it is what this program makes central. Here, direct bonuses require funded members, binary qualification requires one recruit on each side, spillover organizes additional recruits, and larger account amounts unlock deeper levels. Those are the mechanism of the promoted earnings, while the absence of a proven payment does not make the solicitation ordinary commerce.
